business_summary: Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd. engages in the pharmaceutical retail business in China. The company offers pharmaceuticals, health food, personal care products, household health products, convenience food, and daily consumables through community clinics and convenience stores. The company was formerly known as Yunnan Jianzhijia Health-Chain Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd. in September 2022. Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Kunming, China.
business_summary_ko: Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 의약품 소매 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 지역의료원과 편의점을 통해 의약품, 건강식품, 생활건강용품, 생활건강용품, 간편식, 생활소모품 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Yunnan Jianzhijia Health-Chain Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2022년 9월에 Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Jianzhijia Pharmaceutical Chain Group Co., Ltd.는 1998년에 설립되었으며 중국 쿤밍에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
